effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: bunches of flat ribbon streamers hanging from the top of the view, trailing and fluttering in gusts, one instanced draw through the HDR tail, over the page. Every later effect starts from this shape.

effects.title: Banner
effects.summary: A banner hung from a rod by rings across a section heading, carrying its text, stirring in a breeze: XPBD cloth whose every cell the 3D wind pushes on, with light through the fabric and a sheen.

scorecard.fallback: The heading in CSS with a gentle skew wave, or the poster.
